summary: Join specialized training on managing social protection budgets and expenditures. Gain essential skills to effectively allocate resources and improve outcomes.
lede: Managing Social Protection Budgets and Expenditures helps professionals turn social protection budgeting into a strategic tool for planning, allocating, tracking, and defending resources. You will learn to translate priorities into budget terms, develop realistic program costings, and distribute funding across social cash transfers, social insurance, labor market programs, and shock-responsive safety nets. The course also equips you to monitor spending execution, identify under-spending or misalignment, and respond to annual ceilings, donor-funded projects, and emergency reallocations. Through practical scenarios, you will build the confidence to prioritize and justify social protection spending as an investment in people, resilience, and stability.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals who regularly plan, approve, implement, or review social protection budgets and expenditures.
audience: Budget officers and planners in ministries
Program and project managers for cash transfer
modules: Foundations of Social Protection Financing and Budgeting
Mapping and Classifying Social Protection Expenditures
Costing Social Protection Programs and Reforms
Planning and Allocating Social Protection Budgets
Executing and Tracking Social Protection Expenditures
Value for Money and Efficiency in Social Protection Spending
Donor Financing, Domestic Resources, and Fiscal Space
Equity, Targeting, and Trade Offs in Budget Decisions
Risk Management, Shocks, and Adaptive Social Protection Budgets
Communicating and Defending Social Protection Budgets
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of budgeting processes and some experience in managing or reviewing budgets, preferably in a social sector context.
